Anyone as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 45 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 45 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 740 identities would post 4602 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
